From: ben_carter@redwood.ai

Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Unexpected staging-side charge for 'redispatch' batch — internal trace

Grace / Karthik — I pulled the ledger and raw usage for Novacorp for 2026-08-13 21:00 -> 2026-08-14 04:00 UTC. Key findings: 

1) Attribution: 1,803,642 tokens billed under api_key: sk-live-nova-prod, route: /v1/generate, label: redispatcher-staging. That api_key appears to be the org's main key (not sandbox).

2) Cause: Our replayer detected a retry loop from a background job with exponential backoff that replayed a backlog of requests after a transient datastore timeout. The runtime routed the requests to the aux-model fallback (dense-reranker-v2) for a small portion (~7%) due to a model mismatch; aux-model tokens are charged at the standard generation rate.

3) Metering nuance: The replay used continuous-batching with a larger batch size (the batch optimizer elevated concurrency during the catch-up window), which increased per-token compute but should not change token counting. Billing counts tokens consumed by both primary and fallback models.

I exported the per-request sample (usage-export-20260813.json) and marked the suspect request_ids. See comments in the export.

Recommendation: Provisional credit 100% of tokens originating from the backfill if the requests were from an environment intended to be non-billable (staging). Because the api_key is live, we need Novacorp confirmation to reclassify the key or reassign to a sandbox project.

-Ben
Billing Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachment: usage-export-20260813.json (json)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@novacorp.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Unexpected staging-side charge for 'redispatch' batch — engineering notes

Hi Elena — following Ben's export I traced the replay. Some additional technical details: 

- The backlog replayer hit a transient write failure at 2026-08-13T21:08:17Z and retried. A bug in the replayer increments the retry counter but does not set "sandbox=true" metadata when picking up jobs resumed from the staging queue. That means the runtime treated the resumed jobs as normal requests (and not a test run).

- During the catch-up, ~128 requests were routed to dense-reranker-v2 as a fallback; they added ~126k tokens billed under the same request footprint.

We pushed a hotfix to the replayer (fix/replayer-sandbox-flag) that ensures sandbox metadata is preserved on resume. We'll deploy to prod after your sign-off on a non-disruptive maintenance window.

If Novacorp confirms the original job is non-billable, we can backfill a credit for 1,803,642 tokens and mark future resumed jobs appropriately.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Software Engineer — Redwood Inference

Elena
